tools.name: office_space_calculator
tools.description: Estimate usable and rentable office square feet from headcount, growth, desk sharing, rooms, circulation and load factor. Preliminary planning estimate only. The architect's test fit, the building drawings and the permit set govern the actual layout.

tools.name: occupant_load_calculator
tools.description: Minimum design occupant load for a floor area from Ontario Building Code Table 3.1.17.1 area per person values. Preliminary planning figure only. The architect, the engineer and the permit set govern the occupant load used for design and approval.

tools.name: washroom_fixture_calculator
tools.description: Minimum water closets and lavatories for each sex in an Ontario office or retail space (Building Code Tables 3.7.4.7 and 3.7.4.8). Preliminary planning figure only. Accessible and universal washroom rules apply separately. The architect, the engineer and the permit set govern.

tools.name: child_care_space_checker
tools.description: Check indoor play space, outdoor play space and sleeping area per child for an Ontario licensed child care centre. Preliminary planning check only. Licensing is decided by the ministry. The architect, the engineer and the permit set govern the design.

tools.name: restaurant_seating_and_washroom_requirement
tools.description: Occupant load, seat capacity and minimum patron and employee water closets and lavatories for an Ontario restaurant or bar (Building Code Table 3.7.4.3.-D, -E and -F). tools.name: exit_width_and_egress_door_calculator
tools.description: Required exit width, number of exits, door count and travel distance limit for an occupant load under Ontario Building Code Subsections 3.4.2 and 3.4.3. Preliminary planning figure only. The architect, the fire protection engineer and the permit set govern the means of egress.

tools.name: accessible_washroom_clearance_checker
tools.description: Pass or fail check of barrier-free stall, ambulatory stall or universal washroom clear dimensions against Ontario Building Code Articles 3.8.3.8 and 3.8.3.12. tools.name: retail_store_layout_and_aisle_width_calculator
tools.description: Occupant load, exits, aisle widths and accessible route for an Ontario retail store, with a fixture run estimate from shelving depth. Preliminary planning figure only. The architect, the fire protection engineer and the permit set govern the layout and the means of egress.

tools.name: parking_stall_count_for_change_of_use
